hero_title: Light up your space with warmth & soul
hero_sub: Small-batch, handpoured candles and wax sachets made with premium soy wax and carefully curated fragrances — for every mood, every season.
about_text_1: The Cozy Glow began in a small kitchen with a passion for creating spaces that feel safe, warm, and beautiful. Every candle and wax sachet is handcrafted in small batches, ensuring the utmost care in each piece that leaves our hands.
about_text_2: We believe your home deserves the best — pure soy wax, phthalate-free fragrances, and botanicals that tell a story. No fillers, no shortcuts.
